mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-1958, 1928) and has to end up at (-2651, 747.8). On the way it must stop at A (Mathikere Government School) at (-2554, 1021). Keep it no lower than 915.2 m and no higher than 1060.4 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (BLD_way_346135242 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 927.6 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_363125541 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 932 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_363125542 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 929.2 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_777638988 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 966 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_777638989 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 966.8 m; above that it can be overflown]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 1925 meters. (START is Vrushi Apartment; DEST is Ujjni Glitz.) Coordinates are meters east/north of 13.0252 N, 77.5840 E; altitudes are meters above sea level; the ground here lies between 895 and 940 m, and every leg must stay 20-120 m above the ground.

metadata.obstacle_rule: convex hulls of all buildings that reach the band floor and lie within the region reachable under the distance budget (+30 m)
metadata.assumptions: buildings without height data assumed default_height_m; band followed over SRTM terrain; local equirectangular projection
